# costory_billing_datasource_gcp_cud_export (Resource)

Creates a Costory GCP committed-use discount export billing datasource. See the full documentation [here](https://docs.costory.io/setup/billing/gcp-cud-metadata).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    costory = {
      source  = "costory-io/costory"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "costory_api_token" {
  type        = string
  description = "Costory API token."
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "costory" {
  token = var.costory_api_token
}

resource "costory_billing_datasource_gcp_cud_export" "main" {
  name          = "GCP CUD Export"
  bq_table_path = "my-project.billing.cud_export"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bq_table_path` (String) BigQuery table path for the CUD export (`project_id.dataset_id.table_name`).
- `name` (String) Billing datasource display name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Billing datasource ID returned by Costory.
- `status` (String) Datasource status returned by Costory.
- `type` (String) Datasource type. Always `GCP_CUD_EXPORT` for this resource.
